node.title: Rank-stratified capacity removes the first 4589 kernel shortenings
node.closure: canonical-basis capacity sum with exhaustive exact interval replay
node.statement: For every 10<=K'<=4598, the sum over all nine nonzero evaluation-rank strata of C(n',10-d) M_d C(K'-10,d+1) is strictly below the dominant kernel-lane demand (495405467/10^9)N_min C(m',11). At K'=4598 the exact integer gap is 219272330501201744129177266158988707697316238048878827197685. Hence the kernel lane cannot dominate on this interval. At K'=4599 the comparison reverses, so larger shortenings remain open.
